[[House of Organa/Legends|House Organa]] maintained an '''observatory''' in [[King's Pass]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]], in the mountains west of [[House Syrush (estate)|House Syrush]] and north of the [[Ruur Killik Hivewoods]].
